source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 台风逼近 闽浙多地停工停航
topics.official_english: Typhoon Approaches; Fujian and Zhejiang Suspend Work and Ferry Services
topics.why_hot: A typhoon is approaching the southeastern coast, directly affecting work, travel, and public safety in Fujian and Zhejiang.
topics.share_angle: Explain how Chinese coastal provinces prepare for typhoons, including work suspensions, ferry shutdowns, and emergency alerts.

topics.chinese_topic: 未来五年中国民航重磅规划出炉
topics.official_english: China Unveils Five-Year Plan for Civil Aviation Development
topics.why_hot: The new civil aviation blueprint signals how China plans to expand airports, routes, and air travel infrastructure over the next five years.
topics.share_angle: Break down the key areas of the plan, such as airport expansion and regional connectivity, and what they could mean for travelers and the aviation industry.

topics.chinese_topic: 飞机票免费退改真的来了
topics.official_english: Free Flight Ticket Refunds and Changes Become a Reality
topics.why_hot: Ticket refund and change policies affect almost every traveler, and the announcement promises to reduce the cost of changing plans.
topics.share_angle: Outline what is known from the announcement and point viewers to official channels for details on eligibility and procedures.

topics.chinese_topic: “今天得有40℃了吧 为啥还不预警”
topics.official_english: If It Feels Like 40°C, Why Is There No Heat Warning?
topics.why_hot: As cities endure extreme heat, people question when a heat alert should be issued and whether official standards match how hot it actually feels.
topics.share_angle: Compare official heat-warning criteria with public experience and explain why alerts may not be triggered even on very hot days.

topics.chinese_topic: 宇树科技中一签需缴款7.54万元
topics.official_english: Unitree Robotics IPO Requires 75,400 yuan per Allotment
topics.why_hot: Unitree Robotics is a well-known Chinese robotics company, and its IPO subscription figure has become a hot talking point among investors.
topics.share_angle: Contextualize the IPO for a general audience: what Unitree does, why the subscription is pricey, and what the listing could mean for the robotics sector.

topics.chinese_topic: 河南三支一扶笔试成绩作废 将重考
topics.official_english: Henan Invalidates Written Exam Scores in Rural Grassroots Support Program and Schedules Retest
topics.why_hot: Invalidating exam results affects many candidates and raises concerns about fairness and administration in public recruitment exams.
topics.share_angle: Explain the grassroots support program and what the retest means for candidates and the broader recruitment system.

topics.chinese_topic: 高校宣称第一志愿填报该校奖9000元
topics.official_english: University Offers 9,000 yuan Reward for First-Choice Applicants
topics.why_hot: Cash rewards for first-choice college applications are a new tactic in China's intense competition for students, fueling debate about higher education and marketing.
topics.share_angle: Discuss why universities are offering financial incentives and what it signals about enrollment competition and changing demographics.

topics.chinese_topic: 啤酒巨头们正排队“去啤酒化”
topics.official_english: Major Beer Companies Pivot Beyond Beer to Diversify
topics.why_hot: Major beer companies are moving beyond beer as demand changes, making the industry shift a relatable business story.
topics.share_angle: Look at why brewers are diversifying into other drinks and how that reflects changing consumer tastes in China.
